Complete layouts of callback segment lists, bypass queues and sequence comparison and snapshot semantics.
Global grace thread wakeup protocol and node wait queue indexing and completion signaling beyond observed waits.
Full per CPU and global state structures beyond fields touched here, including initialization defaults.

findings.text: Offers a global flush helper that processes deferred wakeup state for the calling processor current per CPU record.

Offers boot time initialization that builds offload mask rcu_nocb_mask, reports selection, prepares per CPU callback lists, registers lazy memory reclaim hooks when enabled, and organizes group threads.
Offers a context switch hook that records a voluntary or preemptive switch, queues a task still inside a read side section, then notes quiescent states for normal, expedited and task flavors.
Offload membership is coupled: link nocb_entry_rdp joins head nocb_head_rdp exactly while marker SEGCBLIST_OFFLOADED is set; toggling flips marker and linkage together.
Group wait preserves smallest pending norm and smallest pending exp across members needing grace, storing them in record nocb_gp_seq and setting flags nocb_gp_gp plus nocb_gp_bypass and lazy state.

Bypass content is classified as lazy only when bypass count equals lazy length lazy_len; mixed or non lazy bypass selects bypass deferred wakeup RCU_NOCB_WAKE_BYPASS, lazy only selects lazy wakeup RCU_NOCB_WAKE_LAZY, and polling flag rcu_nocb_poll disables deferred timers.
Lazy reclaim reporting sums lazy lengths over offload mask rcu_nocb_mask; empty total reports SHRINK_EMPTY, scan decrements requested budget nr_to_scan and reports SHRINK_STOP when nothing reclaimed.

Stride rcu_nocb_gp_stride defaults to negative one meaning automatic sizing from processor count; boot grouping assigns every possible processor a leader pointer nocb_gp_rdp at stride boundaries and links only mask members into leader collections.
After each group cycle stored sequences norm and exp in nocb_gp_seq reset to invalid all ones pattern; callback flag nocb_cb_sleep ends true only when no ready callbacks remain.
Per CPU lock nocb_lock serializes toggle of offload state and list linkage and serializes per member inspection, bypass flush, ready check and sleep flag update inside group and callback waits.

Group lock nocb_gp_lock serializes pending pointer nocb_toggling_rdp, cancellation of deferred wakeup, and group flag nocb_gp_sleep; polling path uses locked clear of toggle pointer before state changes.

Tree node lock is taken while interrupts are already disabled to advance callbacks when tail marker RCU_NEXT_READY_TAIL shows work or waited sequence cur_gp_seq appears complete; callback path uses nonblocking attempt under same interrupt condition.

Global mutex nocb_mutex is acquired only with trylock during lazy reclaim to avoid allocation dependency deadlock; callback execution runs with bottom half disabled and momentary extended quiescent state around batch processing with interrupts enabled on exit.

Per CPU record holds placement via cpu and mynode, grouping via leader nocb_gp_rdp with head nocb_head_rdp and link nocb_entry_rdp, protection via nocb_lock and nocb_gp_lock, waiting via queue nocb_gp_wq with flag nocb_gp_sleep and via queue nocb_cb_wq with flag nocb_cb_sleep, queueing via list cblist and bypass nocb_bypass with length lazy_len, progress via sequences nocb_gp_seq and counter nocb_gp_loops plus flags nocb_gp_bypass and nocb_gp_gp, reconfiguration via pointer nocb_toggling_rdp with queue nocb_state_wq, and timing via nocb_timer.

Tree node holds sequencing via gp_seq and completedqs, membership via masks qsmask and expmask with init copies qsmaskinit and qsmaskinitnext, blocked queueing via list blkd_tasks with markers gp_tasks and exp_tasks, and group waiting via indexed queues nocb_gp_wq selected by sequence counter parity.

Task linkage uses node rcu_node_entry for queueing, pointer rcu_blocked_node to blocking node, and nested flag blocked inside record rcu_read_unlock_special; grace tracking uses paired record rcu_gp_seq holding norm and exp numbers.

Group thread cycles through scanning members and waking callback threads and global grace thread, recording group bypass and wait needs, then either polling with idle delay, sleeping for new callbacks via queue nocb_gp_wq, or waiting on node queue for earliest sequence, finally handling one pending toggle and waking its state queue.

Callback thread cycles between waiting for flag nocb_cb_sleep to clear or park request, honoring park only when already marked sleeping, executing one ready batch outside locks with bottom half disabled, then rechecking completion and setting sleeping true when no ready work remains.

Newly blocked insertion selects head, tail, after first normal marker gp_tasks, or after first expedited marker exp_tasks based on combined state blkd_state built from occupancy and blocking bits RCU_GP_TASKS and RCU_EXP_TASKS and RCU_GP_BLKD and RCU_EXP_BLKD; first blockers update corresponding markers.

Switch handling moves from utilization tracing through either queueing a reader still nested per depth rcu_preempt_depth with online and list sanity checks or processing deferred quiescent state, then noting local quiescent state and reporting expedited and task quiescent states before ending tracing.

Group and callback kernel threads are persistent entries that count loops via nocb_gp_loops or directly wait, invoke corresponding wait routine, and yield for quiescent state every iteration without terminating.
Deferred timer, current CPU flush helper, lazy count and scan callbacks, boot initializer, and switch hook form external entry surface observed in this lane.

Concurrent deoffload plus immediate reoffload can carry group scan cursor to list end and skip unvisited members; safety relies on forcing fresh full scan after any membership addition rather than on scan atomicity.

Parking callback thread assumes preceding barrier and warns if callbacks remain while marked sleeping; empty wakeups and pending signals warn, and online, leaf, mask and list states are checked as unexpected rather than handled.

Reclaim paths must not block on global mutex and must recheck lazy length under per CPU lock because increments can race without bypass lock; offload status is revalidated and unexpected non offloaded members are skipped.
Identifier RCU_GP_TASKS denotes numeric value eight for encoding presence of normal grace blocked tasks.
Identifier RCU_EXP_TASKS denotes numeric value four for encoding presence of expedited grace blocked tasks.
Identifier RCU_GP_BLKD denotes numeric value two for encoding that current processor blocks normal grace progress.
Identifier RCU_EXP_BLKD denotes numeric value one for encoding that current processor blocks expedited grace progress.
